about: Conformance vectors for the receipt format (docs/SPEC.md). Run each row's args from inside this folder; the exit and the last line of stdout must be as given. See README.md.

vectors.name: genesis-only
vectors.about: A chain of its genesis alone.

vectors.name: genesis-only-head
vectors.about: The head of a genesis-only chain is the genesis entry's hash.

vectors.name: valid-chain
vectors.about: Genesis and three entries, one with a file reference, as the recorder wrote them.

vectors.name: valid-chain-files
vectors.about: The file reference checked against notes.txt beside the chain: CURRENT, then VALID.

vectors.name: valid-chain-head
vectors.about: head prints the last entry's entry_hash.

vectors.name: expect-head-match
vectors.about: The head record matches the chain head.

vectors.name: expect-head-mismatch
vectors.about: A head record from another chain: internally valid, but not the recorded history.
vectors.last_line: HEAD-MISMATCH: chain head is fab3462eec002f8cfca9c05ffdee3f05c348388c6a5e470b6235476ae3fafb35, expected 6da336801769a2bb75cc6a22c67c852069597548afd3d0fa20e822951169ec11 — this is not the recorded history

vectors.name: entry-edited
vectors.about: Entry 2's action edited, its hash left as it was.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 2: entry_hash does not match canonical form

vectors.name: entry-deleted
vectors.about: Entry 2 removed: the next entry's n and prev no longer fit.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 2: prev does not match predecessor's entry_hash

vectors.name: entries-swapped
vectors.about: Entries 1 and 2 swapped.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 3: prev does not match predecessor's entry_hash

vectors.name: tail-truncated
vectors.about: The last entry cut away cleanly: the rest walks clean, which is why a head record is kept.

vectors.name: tail-truncated-expect-head
vectors.about: The same cut, against the head recorded before it.
vectors.last_line: HEAD-MISMATCH: chain head is 6da336801769a2bb75cc6a22c67c852069597548afd3d0fa20e822951169ec11, expected fab3462eec002f8cfca9c05ffdee3f05c348388c6a5e470b6235476ae3fafb35 — this is not the recorded history

vectors.name: tail-torn
vectors.about: The last line cut off mid-write, with no line ending: the signature of a crash, named as such.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN: torn tail at line 3 (crash-truncated append; entries 0..2 intact)

vectors.name: tail-torn-head
vectors.about: A torn tail has no head: nothing on stdout, the reason on stderr.

vectors.name: key-given-twice
vectors.about: Entry 3 names action twice; its hash holds for the last of the two.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 3: key 'action' given twice

vectors.name: wrong-type-files
vectors.about: Entry 3's files is a string, with a hash that holds for it.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 3: files is not an array

vectors.name: wrong-type-n
vectors.about: Entry 3's n is true, a boolean, with a hash that holds for it.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 3: n is not an integer

vectors.name: non-ascii
vectors.about: CJK and an emoji, stored as the recorder writes them: \u escapes, the emoji as a surrogate pair. The canonical form holds them as UTF-8.

canonical.text: {"action":"記録を書いた 🐘 象","actor":"エージェント","files":[],"n":1,"prev":"f20b1b3b9b0dd649fc6f00125ad29f374143b0d5c0b4d0a68749bbb5657c1fd4","ts":"2026-09-23T12:01:00Z"}

vectors.name: non-ascii-raw
vectors.about: The same entries stored as raw UTF-8: another spelling of the line, the same hashes.

vectors.name: non-ascii-raw-head
vectors.about: Its head is the non-ascii chain's head.

vectors.name: escapes
vectors.about: An action needing every escape SPEC section 4 pins, exactly as RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.2 spells them: \" and \\, the short forms \b \t \n \f \r, lowercase \u00xx for the other controls, and DEL, NEL, U+2028 and U+2029 as they stand.

vectors.name: escapes-other-spelling
vectors.about: The same entry, its action stored as uppercase \u escapes throughout: the line is spelled differently, the canonical form is not, and the hash holds.

vectors.name: escapes-hashed-wrong
vectors.about: The same entry hashed over a canonical form that spells its controls as uppercase \u hex and escapes DEL, NEL and the separators: what a verifier with other escaping would compute. It does not hold.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 1: entry_hash does not match canonical form

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-text
vectors.about: The escape text the recorder writes for a lone surrogate (#292): six ASCII characters, canonical like any text.

vectors.name: lone-surrogate-json
vectors.about: The same entry with the escape read as JSON: a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 form and so no canonical form.
vectors.last_line: BROKEN at entry 1: a string holds a lone surrogate, which has no canonical form

vectors.name: transcript-commitment
vectors.about: Two transcript commitments (SPEC section 2.2), byte counts growing: judged from the chain alone.

vectors.name: transcript-commitment-transcript
vectors.about: The same chain against transcript.txt: both commitments hold, and the tail after them is stated.

vectors.name: transcript-commitment-shrank
vectors.about: A later commitment of fewer bytes than an earlier one: a growing transcript never shrinks.
vectors.last_line: TRANSCRIPT-DIVERGED: chain intact, but a committed transcript prefix no longer holds

vectors.name: unsupported-version
vectors.about: Genesis claims format 0.2, every hash holding.
vectors.last_line: UNSUPPORTED-VERSION: log is format "0.2"; this verifier speaks "0.1"

vectors.name: unsupported-version-edited
vectors.about: Genesis claims format 0.2 and entry 2 is edited. Today's behaviour: the version refusal comes before the walk. The #299 ruling to freeze the hashing makes this BROKEN, exit 1.
vectors.last_line: UNSUPPORTED-VERSION: log is format "0.2"; this verifier speaks "0.1"
